user.title: Connect your receipt printer
user.description: Enter the printer's IP address. Give it a static IP or a DHCP reservation so it doesn't move. Tiny Press talks raw ESC/POS on port 9100.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Epson TM printer.
data_description.port: Raw printing port. Epson TM printers use 9100.

discovery_confirm.title: Epson receipt printer found
discovery_confirm.description: Set up the receipt printer at {host} as Tiny Press?

paper.title: Paper
paper.description: Pick the paper roll width loaded in the printer. On the TM-m30III, 58 mm paper also needs the 58 mm roll guide fitted and the width changed in the printer's settings.

error.no_status: Connected, but the device didn't answer ESC/POS status requests. Is it an Epson TM receipt printer?
error.test_page_failed: The test page couldn't be sent. Untick it to continue, or check the printer.

abort.not_receipt_printer: The discovered Epson device doesn't answer receipt-printer status requests.

data.ai_jokes: Use AI for jokes and fun facts
data.bottom_source: Bottom of the slip: content source

data_description.max_length_mm: Any print longer than this is trimmed, so a runaway print can't empty the roll.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to read paper and cover status. Status is never read while printing.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Optional. Used for bedtime stories in a later version, and for jokes and fun facts if you switch that on below.
data_description.ai_jokes: Off (recommended): jokes and facts come from Tiny Press's bundled, human-written lists, each with a credited source. On: ask the AI task entity first and fall back to the bundled lists.
data_description.weather_entity: Used by the Weather print and the morning slip. Not needed if you only have one weather entity.
data_description.calendar_entities: Today's events from these calendars print on the morning slip, all-day events first.
data_description.todo_entities: Optional. Unchecked items from these lists print as checkboxes. Leave empty for no to-dos.
data_description.morning_bottom: What prints at the end of the morning slip.
data_description.morning_feed: The 3 newest headlines from this feed print on the morning slip, above its bottom. Leave empty for no headlines.
data_description.quiet_start: No feed auto-prints during quiet hours. Clear both times to allow printing at any hour.
data_description.quiet_end: Quiet hours can span midnight, such as 9 PM to 7 AM.
data_description.quiet_mode: Skip new feed items, or print up to 3 per feed when quiet hours end.
data_description.bottom_source: Online uses live sources where one exists (today: Wikiquote's quote of the day for the Quote bottom, credited on the print), falling back to the bundled content. A feed takes the quote from the Quote feed below. Local uses only the bundled content, with no internet. Joke and fact AI is a separate setting above.
data_description.quote_feed: Used when the content source is "A feed": the newest item's summary is the quote and its title the author.

add_kid.title: Add a kid
add_kid.description: Profiles set the word lists and math level. Interests show up in word searches.

data_description.grade: Used by word searches, spelling and stories.
data_description.interests: Free text, for example: dinosaurs, space, horses.
data_description.stretch: Make puzzles one grade harder (reading and math).
data_description.spelling_todo: The only source of spelling words: a to-do list with one word per item. Check a word off once it's learned; the spelling prints use the unchecked words. Without a list, or with every word checked off, the Spelling tile is greyed out on the card.
data_description.math_grade: Used by math strips and kid sudoku. Grade 1 is single-digit addition and subtraction.
data_description.maze_difficulty: This kid's mazes. "Follow the Maze difficulty select" uses the device's select; asking for a level ("print a hard maze") still wins.
data_description.ha_user: Optional. When this person is logged in, the Tiny Press card shows only their prints, limits and story, and kid-mode limits always apply to them.
data_description.daily_limit: Optional. This kid's own daily print limit when kid-mode limits are on. Leave empty to use the Prints per day under Kid-mode limits. The cooldown, hourly and paper limits still apply.

kid_limits.title: Kid-mode limits
kid_limits.description: Limits apply to kid prints (maze, word search, math, joke, fun fact, kid pack) from every button, dashboard card, voice phrase and Siri shortcut. Parents can skip them with `ignore_limits: true` on an action. Counts reset at midnight.

data_description.limit_admins_skip: Leave off if a shared wall tablet is signed in as an admin.

add_feed.title: Add a feed
add_feed.description: Any RSS or Atom feed (news, a blog, a podcast). Tiny Press reads it only when you print it, and prints headlines, dates and short summaries, never pictures.

data_description.name: Shown on the print and used by voice: "print the headlines from BBC News".
data_description.url: The feed's address, usually ending in /rss, /feed or .xml.
data_description.items: How many of the newest items to print (1–10).

feed_settings.title: {name}
feed_settings.description: Auto-print prints a short slip each time this feed adds an item. The first check only notes what's already there, so no backlog prints. At most 3 slips print per check, and items older than 12 hours are skipped. Quiet hours are set for all feeds under Settings. Auto slips never count toward kid-mode limits.

data_description.items: For the Print feed action and buttons (1–10).
data_description.check_minutes: How often to look for new items (5–1440 minutes).
data_description.auto_qr: A small QR code that opens the item on a phone.

holidays.title: Holidays and themes
holidays.description: Recognized days get a banner with ASCII art on the morning slip, on the day itself only. Faith and cultural holidays come in groups, all off by default, and are treated the same way.

data_description.theme: Auto themes word searches, crosswords, mazes, jokes and facts for today's holiday, or else the season (which follows your hemisphere). Kid interests still mix in.
data_description.secular_days: On by default: seasons and solstices, fun science days, public holidays, and the first day of school.
data_description.holiday_calendars: Calendars from the Holidays integration (Settings → Devices & services → Add → Holidays). Today's all-day events print as banners. Note: a country's public holidays can include religious days (for example Christmas or Good Friday), which print even if that holiday group is off.
data_description.school_day: Prints a back-to-school banner on this date.
data_description.holiday_groups: Tick the groups your household celebrates or wants to learn about. Next, you can untick single days.

holiday_days.title: Holidays to include
holiday_days.description: Untick any day you don't want recognized.

add_day.title: Add a family day
add_day.description: A day that comes around every year, such as a birthday, name day or local festival.

data_description.date: Only the month and day are used; it repeats every year.
data_description.art: Pick a piece of art for the banner, or none.

error.name_exists: A profile with this name already exists.
error.feed_exists: A feed with this name already exists.
error.invalid_url: Enter a web address starting with https:// or http://.
error.cannot_read_feed: Couldn't read an RSS or Atom feed at that address. Check the URL.

options.kid_pack: Kid pack (maze, word search and math)

options.quote: A quote of the day (Wikiquote when the source is Online, else public domain)
options.word: A hard vocabulary word with its definition

options.morning: Print them when quiet hours end (up to 3)

options.online: Online, with bundled content as the fallback
options.feed: A feed (pick the quote feed below), with bundled content as the fallback

options.east_asian: East Asian festivals (Lunar New Year, Mid-Autumn, Chuseok, Obon)
options.jewish: Jewish holidays (Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Sukkot, Hanukkah, Purim, Passover)
options.muslim: Muslim holidays (start of Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha)
options.hindu: Hindu festivals (Makar Sankranti and Pongal, Holi, Dussehra, Diwali, Onam)
options.sikh: Sikh holidays (Vaisakhi, Guru Nanak's birthday, Diwali as Bandi Chhor Divas)
options.heritage: Cultural and heritage days, US (Juneteenth, Indigenous Peoples' Day, Día de los Muertos, Kwanzaa)
options.fun: Fun days (Valentine's Day, Halloween, New Year's Eve)

printer_offline.title: {name} has been offline for a day
printer_offline.description: Home Assistant hasn't reached the receipt printer since {since}. Check that it's switched on and connected, and that its IP address hasn't changed. This message clears itself once the printer answers again.

not_loaded.message: No Tiny Press printer is set up and loaded.

entry_not_found.message: That Tiny Press printer isn't set up or isn't loaded.

choose_printer.message: More than one Tiny Press printer is set up. Choose one with config_entry_id.

print_failed.message: The printer didn't take the job: {error}

path_not_allowed.message: {path} isn't allowed. Use a file under /media or /config/www.

image_not_found.message: {path} isn't an image file Tiny Press can read.

rate_limited_cooldown.message: Just a moment! The next print is ready at {time}.

rate_limited_hour.message: That's lots of printing for now. Try again at {time}.

rate_limited_day.message: That's enough printing for today! See you tomorrow.

rate_limited_paper.message: Today's paper is all used up. See you tomorrow!

no_answers.message: There's no answer key for {print_id}. Answer keys are kept for the last 20 puzzles.

weather_not_set.message: Choose a weather entity under Configure → Settings to print the weather.

no_spelling_words.message: {profile} has no spelling words yet. Choose a spelling to-do list under Configure → Edit a profile and add words to it.

all_words_learned.message: {profile} has learned every word on the spelling list. Add new words (or uncheck some) to print more practice.

no_story_in_progress.message: {profile} has no story in progress. Start one with Bedtime story in choose-your-own-adventure mode.

story_preview.message: Stories can't be previewed. Print one with tiny_press.print_story.

morning_once_a_day.message: The morning slip has already been printed from the kid dashboard today. See you tomorrow!

morning_preview.message: The morning slip can't be previewed. Print it with tiny_press.print_morning_slip.

history_unavailable.message: History needs the Recorder integration, which isn't running.

history_bad_period.message: The start of the period must be before the end.

no_feeds.message: No feeds are set up yet. Add one under Configure → Add a feed.

topic.name: Topic

length.name: Length

mode.name: Mode

continue_story.name: Continue story

profile.name: Kid
profile.description: Kid profile name. Empty uses the Kid profile select. The kid's name is never sent to the AI.

choice.name: Choice
choice.description: A or B, as circled on the last chapter. Empty: the gentler option.

final.name: Final chapter
final.description: Wrap the story up with a cozy ending.

length.name: Length
length.description: Short, medium or long. Empty uses the Story length select.

ignore_limits.name: Ignore kid limits
ignore_limits.description: For parents' scripts and dashboards: print even if kid-mode limits would block it.

print_morning_slip.name: Print morning slip
print_morning_slip.description: Prints today's date, weather, calendar events, optional to-dos and a joke, fun fact or small puzzle. Manual only. It doesn't count toward kid-mode limits.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

kid_mode.name: Kid mode
kid_mode.description: Set by kid-mode dashboard cards: allows one morning slip per day.

print_history.name: Print history
print_history.description: Prints the history of one to three entities over a period: a graph (or a timeline for on/off sensors) with a summary, and optionally a table.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: One to three entities. Numeric sensors with the same unit share a graph.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back, instead of hours. Periods over 3 days use hourly statistics.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of a specific period (instead of hours or days).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period. Default: now.

style.name: Style
style.description: Graph and summary (default), table and summary, or both.

tall.name: Tall graph
tall.description: Draw the graph long and turn it onto the strip: turn the receipt sideways to read it, header at the bottom and time running along the paper. Good for several days.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional heading. Default: the entities' names.

grid.name: Grid
grid.description: Add time gridlines and a frame to the graph.

voice_print.name: Voice print
voice_print.description: Prints from a voice request and returns `speech` to say back, even when nothing printed (kid-mode limits, printer offline). Used by the voice phrases blueprint.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

type.name: Type
type.description: What to print. Note prints dictated text and never counts toward kid-mode limits.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Kid or adult profile name, as spoken. Unknown names use the active profile.

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Loose difficulty words such as easy or hard.

sentence.name: Sentence
sentence.description: The whole spoken sentence. A difficulty word in it ("print a hard maze") is used when difficulty isn't given.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Feed name, as spoken, for type feed. Empty uses the first feed.

print_feed.name: Print feed
print_feed.description: Prints the newest items from a feed set up under Configure → Add a feed: headline, date and a short summary, with an optional QR code per item.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Feed name or ID. Empty prints the first feed.

items.name: Items
items.description: How many of the newest items (1–10). Empty uses the feed's setting.

qr.name: QR codes
qr.description: Print a small QR code under each item that opens it on a phone. Makes the print longer.
